verses.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Sha'ul, when Dawid was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and Dawid had abode two days in Ziklag;
verses.am: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

verses.en: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Sha'ul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to Dawid, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
verses.am: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and {so} it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Yisra'el am I escaped.
verses.am: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Sha'ul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
verses.am: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also. {How...: Heb. What was, etc}

verses.en: And Dawid said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Sha'ul and Jonathan his son be dead?
verses.am: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

verses.en: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Sha'ul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
verses.am: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

verses.en: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
verses.am: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here {am} I. {Here...: Heb. Behold me}

verses.en: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
verses.am: And he said unto me, Who {art} thou? And I answered him, I {am} an Amalekite.

verses.en: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
verses.am: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life {is} yet whole in me. {anguish...: or, my coat of mail (or, my embroidered coat) hindereth me, that my, etc}

verses.en: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
verses.am: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that {was} upon his head, and the bracelet that {was} on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

verses.en: Then Dawid took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
verses.am: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that {were} with him:

verses.en: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Sha'ul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of YAHUAH, and for the house of Yisra'el; because they were fallen by the sword.
verses.am: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
verses.am: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence {art} thou? And he answered, I {am} the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy YAHUAH's anointed?
verses.am: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD'S anointed?

verses.en: And Dawid called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
verses.am: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, {and} fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain YAHUAH's anointed.
verses.am: And David said unto him, Thy blood {be} upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD'S anointed.

verses.en: And Dawid lamented with this lamentation over Sha'ul and over Jonathan his son:
verses.am: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

verses.en: (Also he bade them teach the children of Yehudah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
verses.am: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah {the use of} the bow: behold, {it is} written in the book of Jasher.) {of Jasher: or, of the upright}

verses.en: The beauty of Yisra'el is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
verses.am: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

verses.en: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
verses.am: Tell {it} not in Gath, publish {it} not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

verses.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Sha'ul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
verses.am: Ye mountains of Gilboa, {let there be} no dew, neither {let there be} rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, {as though he had} not {been} anointed with oil.

verses.en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Sha'ul returned not empty.
verses.am: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

verses.en: Sha'ul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
verses.am: Saul and Jonathan {were} lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions. {pleasant: or, sweet}

verses.en: Ye daughters of Yisra'el, weep over Sha'ul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
verses.am: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with {other} delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

verses.en: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
verses.am: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, {thou wast} slain in thine high places.

verses.en: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
verses.am: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

verses.en: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
verses.am: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Dawid enquired of YAHUAH, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Yehudah? And YAHUAH said unto him, Go up. And Dawid said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

verses.en: So Dawid went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
verses.am: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

verses.en: And his men that were with him did Dawid bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
verses.am: And his men that {were} with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

verses.en: And the men of Yehudah came, and there they anointed Dawid king over the house of Yehudah. And they told Dawid, saying, That the men of Jabeshgilead were they that buried Sha'ul.
verses.am: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, {That} the men of Jabeshgilead {were they} that buried Saul.

verses.en: And Dawid sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of YAHUAH, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Sha'ul, and have buried him.
verses.am: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed {be} ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, {even} unto Saul, and have buried him.

verses.en: And now YAHUAH shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
verses.am: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

verses.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Sha'ul is dead, and also the house of Yehudah have anointed me king over them.
verses.am: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them. {be ye...: Heb. be ye the sons of valour}

verses.en: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Sha'ul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Sha'ul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
verses.am: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim; {Saul's host: Heb. the host which was Saul's} {Ishbosheth: or, Eshbaal}

verses.en: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Yisra'el.
verses.am: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

verses.en: Ishbosheth Sha'ul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Yisra'el, and reigned two years. But the house of Yehudah followed Dawid.
verses.am: Ishbosheth Saul's son {was} forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

verses.en: And the time that Dawid was king in Hebron over the house of Yehudah was seven years and six months.
verses.am: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months. {time: Heb. number of days}

verses.en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Sha'ul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.am: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of Dawid, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.am: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool. {together: Heb. them together}

verses.en: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
verses.am: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

verses.en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Sha'ul, and twelve of the servants of Dawid.
verses.am: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which {pertained} to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

verses.en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
verses.am: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and {thrust} his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which {is} in Gibeon. {Helkathhazzurim: that is, The field of strong men}

verses.en: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Yisra'el, before the servants of Dawid.
verses.am: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

verses.en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
verses.am: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel {was as} light of foot as a wild roe. {of foot: Heb. of his feet} {as a wild...: Heb. as one of the roes that is in the field}

verses.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
verses.am: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner. {from...: Heb. from after Abner}

verses.en: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
verses.am: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, {Art} thou Asahel? And he answered, I {am}.

verses.en: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
verses.am: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him. {armour: or, spoil}

verses.en: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
verses.am: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

verses.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
verses.am: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth {rib}, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, {that} as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

verses.en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.am: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that {lieth} before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
verses.am: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

verses.en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
verses.am: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

verses.en: And Joab said, As YAHUAH liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
verses.am: And Joab said, {As} God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother. {in the...: Heb. from the morning} {gone...: or, gone away}

verses.en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Yisra'el no more, neither fought they any more.
verses.am: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

verses.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
verses.am: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

verses.en: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of Dawid's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
verses.am: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

verses.en: But the servants of Dawid had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
verses.am: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, {so that} three hundred and threescore men died.

verses.en: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
verses.am: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which {was in} Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

verses.en: Now there was long war between the house of Sha'ul and the house of Dawid: but Dawid waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Sha'ul waxed weaker and weaker.
verses.am: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

verses.en: And unto Dawid were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.am: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

verses.en: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.am: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; {Chileab: or, Daniel}

verses.en: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.am: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

verses.en: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah Dawid's wife. These were born to Dawid in Hebron.
verses.am: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.en: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Sha'ul and the house of Dawid, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Sha'ul.
verses.am: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

verses.en: And Sha'ul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
verses.am: And Saul had a concubine, whose name {was} Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and {Ishbosheth} said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?

verses.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Yehudah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Sha'ul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of Dawid, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
verses.am: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, {Am} I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

verses.en: So do YAHUAH to Abner, and more also, except, as YAHUAH hath sworn to Dawid, even so I do to him;
verses.am: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

verses.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Sha'ul, and to set up the throne of Dawid over Yisra'el and over Yehudah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
verses.am: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.

verses.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
verses.am: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

verses.en: And Abner sent messengers to Dawid on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Yisra'el unto thee.
verses.am: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose {is} the land? saying {also}, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand {shall be} with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

verses.en: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Sha'ul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
verses.am: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face. {that is: Heb. saying}

verses.en: And Dawid sent messengers to Ishbosheth Sha'ul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
verses.am: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver {me} my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

verses.en: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
verses.am: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from {her} husband, {even} from Phaltiel the son of Laish. {Phaltiel: also called, Phalti}

verses.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
verses.am: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned. {along...: Heb. going and weeping}

verses.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Yisra'el, saying, Ye sought for Dawid in times past to be king over you:
verses.am: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past {to be} king over you: {in times...: Heb. both yesterday and the third day}

verses.en: Now then do it: for YAHUAH hath spoken of Dawid, saying, By the hand of my servant Dawid I will save my people Yisra'el out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
verses.am: Now then do {it}: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

verses.en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of Dawid in Hebron all that seemed good to Yisra'el, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.am: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

verses.en: So Abner came to Dawid to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And Dawid made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
verses.am: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that {were} with him a feast.

verses.en: And Abner said unto Dawid, I will arise and go, and will gather all Yisra'el unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And Dawid sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
verses.am: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

verses.en: And, behold, the servants of Dawid and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with Dawid in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
verses.am: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from {pursuing} a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner {was} not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

verses.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
verses.am: When Joab and all the host that {was} with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

verses.en: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
verses.am: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why {is} it {that} thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

verses.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
verses.am: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

verses.en: And when Joab was come out from Dawid, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but Dawid knew it not.
verses.am: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew {it} not.

verses.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.am: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth {rib}, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother. {quietly: or, peaceably}

verses.en: And afterward when Dawid heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before YAHUAH for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
verses.am: And afterward when David heard {it}, he said, I and my kingdom {are} guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner: {blood: Heb. bloods}

verses.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
verses.am: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread. {fail: Heb. be cut off}

verses.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.am: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

verses.en: And Dawid said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king Dawid himself followed the bier.
verses.am: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that {were} with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David {himself} followed the bier. {bier: Heb. bed}

verses.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
verses.am: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

verses.en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
verses.am: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

verses.en: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
verses.am: Thy hands {were} not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, {so} fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him. {wicked...: Heb. children of iniquity}

verses.en: And when all the people came to cause Dawid to eat meat while it was yet day, Dawid sware, saying, So do YAHUAH to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
verses.am: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

verses.en: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.am: And all the people took notice {of it}, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people. {pleased them: Heb. was good in their eyes}

verses.en: For all the people and all Yisra'el understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
verses.am: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

verses.en: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Yisra'el?
verses.am: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

verses.en: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: YAHUAH shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
verses.am: And I {am} this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah {be} too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness. {weak: Heb. tender}

verses.en: And when Sha'ul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Yisra'elites were troubled.
verses.am: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

verses.en: And Sha'ul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
verses.am: And Saul's son had two men {that were} captains of bands: the name of the one {was} Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin: {other: Heb. second}

verses.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
verses.am: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

verses.en: And Jonathan, Sha'ul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Sha'ul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
verses.am: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son {that was} lame of {his} feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name {was} Mephibosheth. {Mephibosheth: or, Meribbaal}

verses.en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
verses.am: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

verses.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
verses.am: And they came thither into the midst of the house, {as though} they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth {rib}: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

verses.en: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
verses.am: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

verses.en: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto Dawid to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Sha'ul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and YAHUAH hath avenged my lord the king this day of Sha'ul, and of his seed.
verses.am: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

verses.en: And Dawid answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As YAHUAH liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
verses.am: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, {As} the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

verses.en: When one told me, saying, Behold, Sha'ul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
verses.am: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who {thought} that I would have given him a reward for his tidings: {thinking...: Heb. he was in his own eyes as a bringer, etc} {who...: or, which was the reward I gave him for his tidings}

verses.en: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
verses.am: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

verses.en: And Dawid commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
verses.am: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged {them} up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried {it} in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

verses.en: Then came all the tribes of Yisra'el to Dawid unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.am: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we {are} thy bone and thy flesh.

verses.en: Also in time past, when Sha'ul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Yisra'el: and YAHUAH said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Yisra'el, and thou shalt be a captain over Yisra'el.
verses.am: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

verses.en: So all the elders of Yisra'el came to the king to Hebron; and king Dawid made a league with them in Hebron before YAHUAH: and they anointed Dawid king over Yisra'el.
verses.am: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.

verses.en: Dawid was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.am: David {was} thirty years old when he began to reign, {and} he reigned forty years.

verses.en: In Hebron he reigned over Yehudah seven years and six months: and in Yerushalayim he reigned thirty and three years over all Yisra'el and Yehudah.
verses.am: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

verses.en: And the king and his men went to Yerushalayim unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto Dawid, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, Dawid cannot come in hither.
verses.am: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither. {thinking...: or, saying David shall not, etc}

verses.en: Nevertheless Dawid took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of Dawid.
verses.am: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same {is} the city of David.

verses.en: And Dawid said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of Dawid's soul, . Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.am: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, {that are} hated of David's soul, {he shall be chief and captain}. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house. {Wherefore...: or, Because they had said, even the blind and the lame, He shall not}

verses.en: So Dawid dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of Dawid. And Dawid built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.am: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

verses.en: And Dawid went on, and grew great, and YAHUAH of hosts was with him.
verses.am: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts {was} with him. {went...: Heb. went, going and growing}

verses.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to Dawid, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built Dawid an house.
verses.am: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house. {masons: Heb. hewers of the stone of the wall}

verses.en: And Dawid perceived that YAHUAH had established him king over Yisra'el, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Yisra'el's sake.
verses.am: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

verses.en: And Dawid took him more concubines and wives out of Yerushalayim, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to Dawid.
verses.am: And David took {him} more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

verses.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Yerushalayim; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Shelomoh,
verses.am: And these {be} the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.am: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.am: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed Dawid king over Yisra'el, all the Philistines came up to seek Dawid; and Dawid heard of it, and went down to the hold.
verses.am: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard {of it}, and went down to the hold.

verses.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.am: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And Dawid enquired of YAHUAH, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And YAHUAH said unto Dawid, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.am: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

verses.en: And Dawid came to Baalperazim, and Dawid smote them there, and said, YAHUAH hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.am: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim. {Baalperazim: that is, the plain of breaches}

verses.en: And there they left their images, and Dawid and his men burned them.
verses.am: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them. {burned...: or, took them away}

verses.en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.am: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And when Dawid enquired of YAHUAH, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.am: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; {but} fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall YAHUAH go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.am: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.en: And Dawid did so, as YAHUAH had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
verses.am: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer. {Geba: also called, Gibeon}

verses.en: Again, Dawid gathered together all the chosen men of Yisra'el, thirty thousand.
verses.am: Again, David gathered together all {the} chosen {men} of Israel, thirty thousand.

verses.en: And Dawid arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Yehudah, to bring up from thence the ark of YAHUAH, whose name is called by the name of YAHUAH of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
verses.am: And David arose, and went with all the people that {were} with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth {between} the cherubims. {Baale: or, Baalah, that is, Kirjathjearim} {whose name...: or, at which the name, even the name of the LORD of hosts, was called upon}

verses.en: And they set the ark of YAHUAH upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
verses.am: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that {was} in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart. {set: Heb. made to ride} {Gibeah: or, the hill}

verses.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of YAHUAH: and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.am: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which {was} at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark. {accompanying: Heb. with}

verses.en: And Dawid and all the house of Yisra'el played before YAHUAH on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
verses.am: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of {instruments made of} fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

verses.en: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of YAHUAH, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
verses.am: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth {his hand} to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook {it}. {Nachon: also called Chidon} {shook it: or, stumbled}

verses.en: And the anger of YAHUAH was kindled against Uzzah; and YAHUAH smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for {his} error; and there he died by the ark of God. {error: or, rashness}

verses.en: And Dawid was displeased, because YAHUAH had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
verses.am: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day. {made: Heb. broken} {Perezuzzah: that is, the breach of Uzzah}

verses.en: And Dawid was afraid of YAHUAH that day, and said, How shall the ark of YAHUAH come to me?
verses.am: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

verses.en: So Dawid would not remove the ark of YAHUAH unto him into the city of Dawid: but Dawid carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.am: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

verses.en: And the ark of YAHUAH continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and YAHUAH blessed Obededom, and all his household.
verses.am: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household.

verses.en: And it was told king Dawid, saying, YAHUAH hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of YAHUAH. So Dawid went and brought up the ark of YAHUAH from the house of Obededom into the city of Dawid with gladness.
verses.am: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that {pertaineth} unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.

verses.en: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of YAHUAH had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
verses.am: And it was {so}, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

verses.en: And Dawid danced before YAHUAH with all his might; and Dawid was girded with a linen ephod.
verses.am: And David danced before the LORD with all {his} might; and David {was} girded with a linen ephod.

verses.en: So Dawid and all the house of Yisra'el brought up the ark of YAHUAH with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.am: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

verses.en: And as the ark of YAHUAH came into the city of Dawid, Michal Sha'ul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king Dawid leaping and dancing before YAHUAH; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.am: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.

verses.en: And they brought in the ark of YAHUAH, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that Dawid had pitched for it: and Dawid offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before YAHUAH.
verses.am: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD. {pitched: Heb. stretched}

verses.en: And as soon as Dawid had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

verses.en: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Yisra'el, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.am: And he dealt among all the people, {even} among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece {of flesh}, and a flagon {of wine}. So all the people departed every one to his house.

verses.en: Then Dawid returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Sha'ul came out to meet Dawid, and said, How glorious was the king of Yisra'el to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.am: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself! {shamelessly: or, openly}

verses.en: And Dawid said unto Michal, It was before YAHUAH, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of YAHUAH, over Yisra'el: therefore will I play before YAHUAH.
verses.am: And David said unto Michal, {It was} before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.

verses.en: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
verses.am: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour. {of the...: or, of the handmaids of my servants}

verses.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Sha'ul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.am: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and YAHUAH had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
verses.am: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

verses.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of YAHUAH dwelleth within curtains.
verses.am: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

verses.en: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for YAHUAH is with thee.
verses.am: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that {is} in thine heart; for the LORD {is} with thee.

verses.en: And it came to pass that night, that the word of YAHUAH came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.am: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

verses.en: Go and tell my servant Dawid, Thus saith YAHUAH, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
verses.am: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in? {my servant...: Heb. to my servant, to David}

verses.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Yisra'el out of Mitsrayim, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.am: Whereas I have not dwelt in {any} house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

verses.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Yisra'el spake I a word with any of the tribes of Yisra'el, whom I commanded to feed my people Yisra'el, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
verses.am: In all {the places} wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar? {any of...: any of the judges}

verses.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant Dawid, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Yisra'el:
verses.am: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel: {from following: Heb. from after}

verses.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.am: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great {men} that {are} in the earth. {out of...: Heb. from thy face}

verses.en: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Yisra'el, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
verses.am: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

verses.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Yisra'el, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also YAHUAH telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
verses.am: And as since the time that I commanded judges {to be} over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

verses.en: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.am: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.en: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.am: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

verses.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
verses.am: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

verses.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Sha'ul, whom I put away before thee.
verses.am: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took {it} from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

verses.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
verses.am: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

verses.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto Dawid.
verses.am: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.en: Then went king Dawid in, and sat before YAHUAH, and he said, Who am I, O YAHUAH? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.am: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who {am} I, O Lord GOD? and what {is} my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

verses.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O YAHUAH; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O YAHUAH?
verses.am: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And {is} this the manner of man, O Lord GOD? {manner: Heb. law}

verses.en: And what can Dawid say more unto thee? for thou, YAHUAH, knowest thy servant.
verses.am: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.

verses.en: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
verses.am: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know {them}.

verses.en: Wherefore thou art great, O YAHUAH: for there is none like thee, neither is there any YAHUAH beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.am: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for {there is} none like thee, neither {is there any} God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Yisra'el, whom YAHUAH went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Mitsrayim, from the nations and their elohim?
verses.am: And what one nation in the earth {is} like thy people, {even} like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, {from} the nations and their gods?

verses.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Yisra'el to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, YAHUAH, art become their YAHUAH.
verses.am: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel {to be} a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.

verses.en: And now, O YAHUAH, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.am: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish {it} for ever, and do as thou hast said.

verses.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, YAHUAH of hosts is YAHUAH over Yisra'el: and let the house of thy servant Dawid be established before thee.
verses.am: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts {is} the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

verses.en: For thou, O YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
verses.am: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee. {revealed: Heb. opened the ear}

verses.en: And now, O YAHUAH, thou art that YAHUAH, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.am: And now, O Lord GOD, thou {art} that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

verses.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O YAHUAH, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
verses.am: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken {it}: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever. {let it...: Heb. be thou pleased and bless}

verses.en: And after this it came to pass, that Dawid smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and Dawid took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.am: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines. {Methegammah: or, the bridle of Ammah}

verses.en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became Dawid's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.am: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And {so} the Moabites became David's servants, {and} brought gifts.

verses.en: Dawid smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.am: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates. {Hadadezer: or, Hadarezer}

verses.en: And Dawid took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and Dawid houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
verses.am: And David took from him a thousand {chariots}, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot {horses}, but reserved of them {for} an hundred chariots. {from...: or, of his chariots}

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, Dawid slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.am: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.en: Then Dawid put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to Dawid, and brought gifts. And YAHUAH preserved Dawid whithersoever he went.
verses.am: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, {and} brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.en: And Dawid took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king Dawid took exceeding much brass.
verses.am: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

verses.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that Dawid had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.am: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

verses.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king Dawid, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.am: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And {Joram} brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass: {Joram: also called, Hadoram} {salute...: Heb. ask him of peace} {had wars...: Heb. was a man of wars with} {brought...: Heb. in his hand were}

verses.en: Which also king Dawid did dedicate unto YAHUAH, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
verses.am: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

verses.en: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.am: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.en: And Dawid gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
verses.am: And David gat {him} a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, {being} eighteen thousand {men}. {smiting: Heb. his smiting}

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became Dawid's servants. And YAHUAH preserved Dawid whithersoever he went.
verses.am: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.en: And Dawid reigned over all Yisra'el; and Dawid executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.am: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.am: And Joab the son of Zeruiah {was} over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud {was} recorder; {recorder: or, remembrancer, or, writer of chronicles}

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.am: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, {were} the priests; and Seraiah {was} the scribe; {scribe: or, secretary}

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and Dawid's sons were chief rulers.
verses.am: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was over} both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers. {chief rulers: or, princes}

verses.en: And Dawid said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Sha'ul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
verses.am: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?

verses.en: And there was of the house of Sha'ul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto Dawid, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
verses.am: And {there was} of the house of Saul a servant whose name {was} Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, {Art} thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant {is he}.

verses.en: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Sha'ul, that I may shew the kindness of YAHUAH unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.
verses.am: And the king said, {Is} there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, {which is} lame on {his} feet.

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
verses.am: And the king said unto him, Where {is} he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he {is} in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.

verses.en: Then king Dawid sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
verses.am: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.

verses.en: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Sha'ul, was come unto Dawid, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And Dawid said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
verses.am: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant! {Mephibosheth: also called Meribbaal}

verses.en: And Dawid said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Sha'ul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verses.am: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

verses.en: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
verses.am: And he bowed himself, and said, What {is} thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I {am}?

verses.en: Then the king called to Ziba, Sha'ul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Sha'ul and to all his house.
verses.am: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

verses.en: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.am: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in {the fruits}, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

verses.en: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.
verses.am: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, {said the king}, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.

verses.en: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
verses.am: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name {was} Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba {were} servants unto Mephibosheth.

verses.en: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Yerushalayim: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
verses.am: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

verses.en: Then said Dawid, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And Dawid sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And Dawid's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
verses.am: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

verses.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that Dawid doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not Dawid rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
verses.am: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David {rather} sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it? {Thinkest...: Heb. In thine eyes doth David}

verses.en: Wherefore Hanun took Dawid's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.am: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, {even} to their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.en: When they told it unto Dawid, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.am: When they told {it} unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and {then} return.

verses.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before Dawid, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.
verses.am: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men. {Ishtob: or, the men of Tob}

verses.en: And when Dawid heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.am: And when David heard of {it}, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
verses.am: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, {were} by themselves in the field.

verses.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Yisra'el, and put them in array against the Syrians:
verses.am: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice {men} of Israel, and put {them} in array against the Syrians:

verses.en: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.am: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put {them} in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.
verses.am: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

verses.en: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our YAHUAH: and YAHUAH do that which seemeth him good.
verses.am: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

verses.en: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
verses.am: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that {were} with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

verses.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Yisra'el, they gathered themselves together.
verses.am: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

verses.en: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.am: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that {were} beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer {went} before them. {the river: that is, Euphrates} {Shobach: or, Shophach}

verses.en: And when it was told Dawid, he gathered all Yisra'el together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against Dawid, and fought with him.
verses.am: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

verses.en: And the Syrians fled before Yisra'el; and Dawid slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.
verses.am: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew {the men of} seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there. {horsemen: also called, footmen}
