verses.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Yisra'el, they made peace with Yisra'el, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.am: And when all the kings {that were} servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.en: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that Dawid sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Yisra'el; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But Dawid tarried still at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth {to battle}, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem. {after...: Heb. at the return of the year, or, in the spring}

verses.en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that Dawid arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
verses.am: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman {was} very beautiful to look upon.

verses.en: And Dawid sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
verses.am: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And {one} said, {Is} not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite? {Bathsheba: or, Bathshuah} {Eliam: or Ammiel}

verses.en: And Dawid sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
verses.am: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house. {for she...: or, and when she had purified herself, etc, she returned}

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and sent and told Dawid, and said, I am with child.
verses.am: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I {am} with child.

verses.en: And Dawid sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to Dawid.
verses.am: And David sent to Joab, {saying}, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.en: And when Uriah was come unto him, Dawid demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
verses.am: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded {of him} how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered. {how Joab...: Heb. of the peace of, etc}

verses.en: And Dawid said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
verses.am: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess {of meat} from the king. {followed...: Heb. went out after him}

verses.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
verses.am: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

verses.en: And when they had told Dawid, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, Dawid said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?
verses.am: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from {thy} journey? why {then} didst thou not go down unto thine house?

verses.en: And Uriah said unto Dawid, The ark, and Yisra'el, and Yehudah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
verses.am: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? {as} thou livest, and {as} thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

verses.en: And Dawid said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Yerushalayim that day, and the morrow.
verses.am: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

verses.en: And when Dawid had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
verses.am: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that Dawid wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.am: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent {it} by the hand of Uriah.

verses.en: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
verses.am: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die. {hottest: Heb. strong} {from him: Heb. from after him}

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men {were}.

verses.en: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of Dawid; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.am: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell {some} of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

verses.en: Then Joab sent and told Dawid all the things concerning the war;
verses.am: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

verses.en: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
verses.am: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

verses.en: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.am: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

verses.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.am: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also. {Jerubbesheth: also called, Jerubbaal}

verses.en: So the messenger went, and came and shewed Dawid all that Joab had sent him for.
verses.am: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

verses.en: And the messenger said unto Dawid, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.am: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.am: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and {some} of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

verses.en: Then Dawid said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
verses.am: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him. {displease...: Heb. be evil in thine eyes} {one...: Heb. so and such}

verses.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.am: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

verses.en: And when the mourning was past, Dawid sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that Dawid had done displeased YAHUAH.
verses.am: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD. {displeased: Heb. was evil in the eyes of}

verses.en: And YAHUAH sent Nathan unto Dawid. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
verses.am: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

verses.en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
verses.am: The rich {man} had exceeding many flocks and herds:

verses.en: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
verses.am: But the poor {man} had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter. {meat: Heb. morsel}

verses.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.
verses.am: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

verses.en: And Dawid's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As YAHUAH liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:
verses.am: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, {As} the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this {thing} shall surely die: {shall...: or, is worthy to die, or, is a son of death}

verses.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
verses.am: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

verses.en: And Nathan said to Dawid, Thou art the man. Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el, I anointed thee king over Yisra'el, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Sha'ul;
verses.am: And Nathan said to David, Thou {art} the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

verses.en: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Yisra'el and of Yehudah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.
verses.am: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if {that had been} too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

verses.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of YAHUAH, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
verses.am: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife {to be} thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

verses.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
verses.am: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.
verses.am: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give {them} unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

verses.en: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Yisra'el, and before the sun.
verses.am: For thou didst {it} secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto Nathan, I have sinned against YAHUAH. And Nathan said unto Dawid, YAHUAH also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
verses.am: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

verses.en: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of YAHUAH to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.
verses.am: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also {that is} born unto thee shall surely die.

verses.en: And Nathan departed unto his house. And YAHUAH struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto Dawid, and it was very sick.
verses.am: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

verses.en: Dawid therefore besought YAHUAH for the child; and Dawid fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.
verses.am: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth. {fasted: Heb. fasted a fast}

verses.en: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.
verses.am: And the elders of his house arose, {and went} to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of Dawid feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?
verses.am: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead? {vex: Heb. do hurt}

verses.en: But when Dawid saw that his servants whispered, Dawid perceived that the child was dead: therefore Dawid said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
verses.am: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

verses.en: Then Dawid arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of YAHUAH, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.
verses.am: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed {himself}, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

verses.en: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.
verses.am: Then said his servants unto him, What thing {is} this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, {while it was} alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

verses.en: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether YAHUAH will be gracious to me, that the child may live?
verses.am: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell {whether} GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

verses.en: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
verses.am: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

verses.en: And Dawid comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Shelomoh: and YAHUAH loved him.
verses.am: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

verses.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD. {Jedidiah: that is, Beloved of the LORD}

verses.en: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
verses.am: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

verses.en: And Joab sent messengers to Dawid, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.
verses.am: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

verses.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.
verses.am: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name. {it be called...: Heb. my name be called upon it}

verses.en: And Dawid gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.
verses.am: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

verses.en: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on Dawid's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.
verses.am: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof {was} a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was {set} on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance. {in great...: Heb. very great}

verses.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So Dawid and all the people returned unto Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And he brought forth the people that {were} therein, and put {them} under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of Dawid had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of Dawid loved her.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name {was} Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

verses.en: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.
verses.am: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she {was} a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her. {Amnon thought...: Heb. it was marvellous, or, hidden in the eyes of Amnon}

verses.en: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah Dawid's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.
verses.am: But Amnon had a friend, whose name {was} Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab {was} a very subtil man.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
verses.am: And he said unto him, Why {art} thou, {being} the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister. {lean: Heb. thin} {from day...: Heb. morning by morning}

verses.en: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.
verses.am: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see {it}, and eat {it} at her hand.

verses.en: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
verses.am: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

verses.en: Then Dawid sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.
verses.am: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.

verses.en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
verses.am: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded {it}, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes. {flour: or, paste}

verses.en: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
verses.am: And she took a pan, and poured {them} out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

verses.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
verses.am: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought {them} into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

verses.en: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
verses.am: And when she had brought {them} unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

verses.en: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Yisra'el: do not thou this folly.
verses.am: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly. {force...: Heb. humble me} {no such...: Heb. it ought not so to be done}

verses.en: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Yisra'el. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.
verses.am: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

verses.en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
verses.am: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

verses.en: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.
verses.am: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her {was} greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone. {exceedingly: Heb. with great hatred greatly}

verses.en: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
verses.am: And she said unto him, {There is} no cause: this evil in sending me away {is} greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

verses.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
verses.am: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this {woman} out from me, and bolt the door after her.

verses.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
verses.am: And {she had} a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters {that were} virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

verses.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
verses.am: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that {was} on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

verses.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
verses.am: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he {is} thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house. {Amnon: Heb. Aminon} {regard...: Heb. set not thy heart} {desolate: Heb. and desolate}

verses.en: But when king Dawid heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
verses.am: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

verses.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.am: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

verses.en: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
verses.am: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which {is} beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.

verses.en: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
verses.am: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

verses.en: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.am: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

verses.en: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
verses.am: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

verses.en: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
verses.am: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.

verses.en: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Marqos ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
verses.am: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant. {have...: or, will you not, since I have commanded you?} {valiant: Heb. sons of valour}

verses.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
verses.am: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled. {gat...: Heb. rode}

verses.en: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to Dawid, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
verses.am: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

verses.en: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
verses.am: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

verses.en: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah Dawid's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.am: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose {that} they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar. {appointment: Heb. mouth} {determined: or, settled}

verses.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
verses.am: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

verses.en: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
verses.am: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

verses.en: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
verses.am: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is. {as thy...: Heb. according to the word of thy servant}

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
verses.am: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore. {very...: Heb. with a great weeping greatly}

verses.en: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And Dawid mourned for his son every day.
verses.am: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And {David} mourned for his son every day. {Ammihud: or, Ammihur}

verses.en: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.am: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

verses.en: And the soul of king Dawid longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
verses.am: And {the soul of} king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead. {longed: or, was consumed}

verses.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
verses.am: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart {was} toward Absalom.

verses.en: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.am: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

verses.en: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.am: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

verses.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.am: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king. {Help: Heb. Save}

verses.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
verses.am: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I {am} indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

verses.en: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
verses.am: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and {there was} none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him. {none...: Heb. no deliverer between them}

verses.en: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
verses.am: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband {neither} name nor remainder upon the earth. {upon...: Heb. upon the face of the earth}

verses.en: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
verses.am: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

verses.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
verses.am: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity {be} on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne {be} guiltless.

verses.en: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
verses.am: And the king said, Whosoever saith {ought} unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

verses.en: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As YAHUAH liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
verses.am: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, {As} the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth. {that...: Heb. that the revenger of blood do not multiply to destroy}

verses.en: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.am: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak {one} word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

verses.en: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of YAHUAH? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
verses.am: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

verses.en: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth YAHUAH respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
verses.am: For we must needs die, and {are} as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect {any} person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him. {neither...: or, because God hath not taken away his life, he hath also devised means, etc}

verses.en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
verses.am: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, {it is} because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

verses.en: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of YAHUAH.
verses.am: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man {that would} destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

verses.en: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of YAHUAH, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore YAHUAH thy YAHUAH will be with thee.
verses.am: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so {is} my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee. {comfortable: Heb. for rest} {to discern: Heb. to hear}

verses.en: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.am: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

verses.en: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
verses.am: And the king said, {Is not} the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, {As} thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

verses.en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of YAHUAH, to know all things that are in the earth.
verses.am: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord {is} wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all {things} that {are} in the earth.

verses.en: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
verses.am: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

verses.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
verses.am: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant. {thanked: Heb. blessed} {his servant: or, thy servant}

verses.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.
verses.am: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.

verses.en: But in all Yisra'el there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.am: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him. {But...: Heb. And as Absalom there was not a beautiful man in all Israel to praise greatly}

verses.en: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
verses.am: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled {it}: because {the hair} was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.

verses.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.am: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name {was} Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

verses.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Yerushalayim, and saw not the king's face.
verses.am: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.

verses.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
verses.am: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

verses.en: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.
verses.am: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire. {near...: Heb. near my place}

verses.en: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
verses.am: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto {his} house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

verses.en: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.am: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? {it had been} good for me {to have been} there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be {any} iniquity in me, let him kill me.

verses.en: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.am: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.en: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was {so}, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city {art} thou? And he said, Thy servant {is} of one of the tribes of Israel. {came: Heb. to come}

verses.en: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
verses.am: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters {are} good and right; but {there is} no man {deputed} of the king to hear thee. {there...: or, none will hear thee from the king downward}

verses.en: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
verses.am: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

verses.en: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
verses.am: And it was {so}, that when any man came nigh {to him} to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

verses.en: And on this manner did Absalom to all Yisra'el that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

verses.en: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto YAHUAH, in Hebron.
verses.am: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.

verses.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If YAHUAH shall bring me again indeed to Yerushalayim, then I will serve YAHUAH.
verses.am: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
verses.am: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

verses.en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Yisra'el, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
verses.am: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

verses.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Yerushalayim, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
verses.am: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, {that were} called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

verses.en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, Dawid's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.am: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, {even} from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

verses.en: And there came a messenger to Dawid, saying, The hearts of the men of Yisra'el are after Absalom.
verses.am: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto all his servants that were with him at Yerushalayim, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.am: And David said unto all his servants that {were} with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not {else} escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword. {bring: Heb. thrust}

verses.en: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
verses.am: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants {are ready to do} whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint. {appoint: Heb. choose}

verses.en: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.
verses.am: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, {which were} concubines, to keep the house. {after...: Heb. at his feet}

verses.en: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
verses.am: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

verses.en: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.am: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

verses.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.
verses.am: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou {art} a stranger, and also an exile.

verses.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.
verses.am: Whereas thou camest {but} yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth {be} with thee. {go up...: Heb. wander in going}

verses.en: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As YAHUAH liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.
verses.am: And Ittai answered the king, and said, {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

verses.en: And Dawid said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.
verses.am: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that {were} with him.

verses.en: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.am: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness. {Kidron: Gr. Cedron}

verses.en: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of YAHUAH: and they set down the ark of YAHUAH; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
verses.am: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites {were} with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

verses.en: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of YAHUAH into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of YAHUAH, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:
verses.am: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me {both} it, and his habitation:

verses.en: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
verses.am: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, {here am} I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

verses.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.am: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, {Art not} thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

verses.en: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
verses.am: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

verses.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of YAHUAH again to Yerushalayim: and they tarried there.
verses.am: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

verses.en: And Dawid went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.am: And David went up by the ascent of {mount} Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that {was} with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up. {and wept...: Heb. going up and weeping}

verses.en: And one told Dawid, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And Dawid said, O YAHUAH, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
verses.am: And {one} told David, saying, Ahithophel {is} among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Dawid was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped YAHUAH, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
verses.am: And it came to pass, that {when} David was come to the top {of the mount}, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

verses.en: Unto whom Dawid said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:
verses.am: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

verses.en: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
verses.am: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; {as} I {have been} thy father's servant hitherto, so {will} I now also {be} thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

verses.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.am: And {hast thou} not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, {that} what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell {it} to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

verses.en: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
verses.am: Behold, {they have} there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's {son}, and Jonathan Abiathar's {son}; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

verses.en: So Hushai Dawid's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Yerushalayim.
verses.am: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

verses.en: And when Dawid was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
verses.am: And when David was a little past the top {of the hill}, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred {loaves} of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

verses.en: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
verses.am: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses {be} for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

verses.en: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Yerushalayim: for he said, To day shall the house of Yisra'el restore me the kingdom of my father.
verses.am: And the king said, And where {is} thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

verses.en: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.
verses.am: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine {are} all that {pertained} unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee {that} I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king. {I humbly...: Heb. I do obeisance}

verses.en: And when king Dawid came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Sha'ul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.
verses.am: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name {was} Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came. {he came forth...: or, he still came forth and cursed}

verses.en: And he cast stones at Dawid, and at all the servants of king Dawid: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
verses.am: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men {were} on his right hand and on his left.

verses.en: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:
verses.am: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial: {bloody...: Heb. man of blood}

verses.en: YAHUAH hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Sha'ul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and YAHUAH hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.
verses.am: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou {art taken} in thy mischief, because thou {art} a bloody man. {behold...: Heb. behold thee in thy evil}

verses.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.
verses.am: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

verses.en: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because YAHUAH hath said unto him, Curse Dawid. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?
verses.am: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

verses.en: And Dawid said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for YAHUAH hath bidden him.
verses.am: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now {may this} Benjamite {do it}? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

verses.en: It may be that YAHUAH will look on mine affliction, and that YAHUAH will requite me good for his cursing this day.
verses.am: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day. {affliction: or, tears: Heb. eye}

verses.en: And as Dawid and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
verses.am: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust. {cast...: Heb. dusted him with dust}

verses.en: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.
verses.am: And the king, and all the people that {were} with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

verses.en: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Yisra'el, came to Yerushalayim, and Ahithophel with him.
verses.am: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, Dawid's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, YAHUAH save the king, YAHUAH save the king.
verses.am: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king. {God...: Heb. Let the king live}

verses.en: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
verses.am: And Absalom said to Hushai, {Is} this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

verses.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom YAHUAH, and this people, and all the men of Yisra'el, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
verses.am: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

verses.en: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
verses.am: And again, whom should I serve? {should I} not {serve} in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

verses.en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
verses.am: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

verses.en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Yisra'el shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.
verses.am: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that {are} with thee be strong.

verses.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Yisra'el.
verses.am: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

verses.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of YAHUAH: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with Dawid and with Absalom.
verses.am: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, {was} as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so {was} all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom. {oracle: Heb. word}

verses.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after Dawid this night:
verses.am: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

verses.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
verses.am: And I will come upon him while he {is} weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that {are} with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

verses.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.
verses.am: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest {is} as if all returned: {so} all the people shall be in peace.

verses.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel. {pleased...: Heb. was right in the eyes of, etc}

verses.en: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
verses.am: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith. {what...: Heb. what is in his mouth}

verses.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.
verses.am: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do {after} his saying? if not; speak thou. {his saying: Heb. his word}

verses.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.
verses.am: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given {is} not good at this time. {given: Heb. counselled}

verses.en: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
verses.am: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they {be} mighty men, and they {be} chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father {is} a man of war, and will not lodge with the people. {chafed...: Heb. bitter of soul}

verses.en: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
verses.am: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some {other} place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom. {overthrown: Heb. fallen}

verses.en: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Yisra'el knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.
verses.am: And he also {that is} valiant, whose heart {is} as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father {is} a mighty man, and {they} which {be} with him {are} valiant men.

verses.en: Therefore I counsel that all Yisra'el be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
verses.am: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that {is} by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person. {that thou...: Heb. that thy face, or, presence go, etc}

verses.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
verses.am: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that {are} with him there shall not be left so much as one.

verses.en: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Yisra'el bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
verses.am: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

verses.en: And Absalom and all the men of Yisra'el said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For YAHUAH had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that YAHUAH might bring evil upon Absalom.
verses.am: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite {is} better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom. {appointed: Heb. commanded}

verses.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Yisra'el; and thus and thus have I counselled.
verses.am: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

verses.en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell Dawid, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.
verses.am: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that {are} with him.

verses.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king Dawid.
verses.am: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

verses.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
verses.am: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

verses.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
verses.am: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

verses.en: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where {is} Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find {them}, they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king Dawid, and said unto Dawid, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
verses.am: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

verses.en: Then Dawid arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
verses.am: Then David arose, and all the people that {were} with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

verses.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.
verses.am: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled {his} ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father. {followed: Heb. done} {put his...: Heb. gave charge concerning his house}

verses.en: Then Dawid came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Yisra'el with him.
verses.am: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

verses.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Yisra'elite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.
verses.am: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa {was} a man's son, whose name {was} Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother. {Ithra an Israelite: or, Jether an Ishmaelite} {Abigail: Heb. Abigal} {Nahash: or, Jesse}

verses.en: So Yisra'el and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
verses.am: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Dawid was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
verses.am: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

verses.en: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
verses.am: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched {corn}, and beans, and lentiles, and parched {pulse}, {basons: or, cups}

verses.en: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for Dawid, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.
verses.am: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that {were} with him, to eat: for they said, The people {is} hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

verses.en: And Dawid numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
verses.am: And David numbered the people that {were} with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

verses.en: And Dawid sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
