verses.am: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

verses.en: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.
verses.am: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now {thou art} worth ten thousand of us: therefore now {it is} better that thou succour us out of the city. {care...: Heb. set their heart on us} {worth...: Heb. as ten thousand of us} {succour: Heb. be to succour or help}

verses.en: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.
verses.am: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
verses.am: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, {Deal} gently for my sake with the young man, {even} with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

verses.en: So the people went out into the field against Yisra'el: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
verses.am: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

verses.en: Where the people of Yisra'el were slain before the servants of Dawid, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.
verses.am: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand {men}.

verses.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
verses.am: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured. {devoured: Heb. multiplied to devour}

verses.en: And Absalom met the servants of Dawid. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.
verses.am: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that {was} under him went away.

verses.en: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
verses.am: And a certain man saw {it}, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

verses.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.
verses.am: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest {him}, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten {shekels} of silver, and a girdle.

verses.en: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
verses.am: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand {shekels} of silver in mine hand, {yet} would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none {touch} the young man Absalom. {receive: Heb. weigh upon mine hand} {Beware...: Heb. Beware whosoever ye be of, etc}

verses.en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.
verses.am: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against {me}.

verses.en: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.
verses.am: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he {was} yet alive in the midst of the oak. {with...: Heb. before thee} {midst: Heb. heart}

verses.en: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
verses.am: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

verses.en: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Yisra'el: for Joab held back the people.
verses.am: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

verses.en: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Yisra'el fled every one to his tent.
verses.am: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

verses.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.
verses.am: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which {is} in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

verses.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that YAHUAH hath avenged him of his enemies.
verses.am: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies. {avenged...: Heb. judged him from the hand, etc}

verses.en: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.
verses.am: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead. {bear tidings this: Heb. be a man of tidings, etc}

verses.en: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.
verses.am: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

verses.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?
verses.am: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready? {howsoever: Heb. be what may} {ready: or, convenient}

verses.en: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
verses.am: But howsoever, {said he}, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

verses.en: And Dawid sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verses.am: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

verses.en: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
verses.am: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he {be} alone, {there is} tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

verses.en: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.
verses.am: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold {another} man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

verses.en: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
verses.am: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He {is} a good man, and cometh with good tidings. {Me...: Heb. I see the running}

verses.en: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
verses.am: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed {be} the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king. {All...: or, Peace be to thee: Heb. Peace} {delivered...: Heb. shut up}

verses.en: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.
verses.am: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and {me} thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what {it was}. {Is...: Heb. Is there peace?}

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
verses.am: And the king said {unto him}, Turn aside, {and} stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

verses.en: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for YAHUAH hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.
verses.am: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee. {Tidings: Heb. Tidings is brought}

verses.en: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.
verses.am: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do {thee} hurt, be as {that} young man {is}.

verses.en: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would YAHUAH I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.am: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.en: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
verses.am: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

verses.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
verses.am: And the victory that day was {turned} into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son. {victory: Heb. salvation, or, deliverance}

verses.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
verses.am: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

verses.en: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.am: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.en: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
verses.am: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

verses.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
verses.am: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well. {in...: Heb. By loving, etc} {that thou regardest...: Heb. that princes or servants are not to thee}

verses.en: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by YAHUAH, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
verses.am: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now. {comfortably...: Heb. to the heart of thy servants}

verses.en: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Yisra'el had fled every man to his tent.
verses.am: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

verses.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Yisra'el, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
verses.am: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

verses.en: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
verses.am: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back? {speak...: Heb. are ye silent?}

verses.en: And king Dawid sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Yehudah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Yisra'el is come to the king, even to his house.
verses.am: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, {even} to his house.

verses.en: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.am: Ye {are} my brethren, ye {are} my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

verses.en: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? YAHUAH do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.am: And say ye to Amasa, {Art} thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

verses.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Yehudah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.am: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as {the heart of} one man; so that they sent {this word} unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

verses.en: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Yehudah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.am: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

verses.en: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Yehudah to meet king Dawid.
verses.am: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which {was} of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

verses.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Sha'ul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.am: And {there were} a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

verses.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.am: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan; {what...: Heb. the good in his eyes}

verses.en: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Yerushalayim, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.am: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

verses.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Yoseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.am: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

verses.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed YAHUAH's anointed?
verses.am: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?

verses.en: And Dawid said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Yisra'el? for do not I know that I am this day king over Yisra'el?
verses.am: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I {am} this day king over Israel?

verses.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.am: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

verses.en: And Mephibosheth the son of Sha'ul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
verses.am: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came {again} in peace.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come to Yerushalayim to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.am: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

verses.en: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
verses.am: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant {is} lame.

verses.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of YAHUAH: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
verses.am: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king {is} as an angel of God: do therefore {what is} good in thine eyes.

verses.en: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.am: For all {of} my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king? {dead...: Heb. men of death}

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.am: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

verses.en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.am: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

verses.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.am: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

verses.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.am: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, {even} fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he {was} a very great man.

verses.en: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Yerushalayim?
verses.am: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem? {How...: Heb. How many days are the years of my life}

verses.en: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.am: I {am} this day fourscore years old: {and} can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

verses.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.am: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

verses.en: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.am: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, {and be buried} by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

verses.en: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
verses.am: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, {that} will I do for thee. {require: Heb. choose}

verses.en: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.am: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

verses.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Yehudah conducted the king, and also half the people of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel. {Chimham: Heb. Chimhan}

verses.en: And, behold, all the men of Yisra'el came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Yehudah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all Dawid's men with him, over Jordan?
verses.am: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

verses.en: And all the men of Yehudah answered the men of Yisra'el, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.am: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king {is} near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's {cost}? or hath he given us any gift?

verses.en: And the men of Yisra'el answered the men of Yehudah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in Dawid than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Yehudah were fiercer than the words of the men of Yisra'el.
verses.am: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more {right} in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel. {despise...: Heb. set us at light}

verses.en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in Dawid, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Yisra'el.
verses.am: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name {was} Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

verses.en: So every man of Yisra'el went up from after Dawid, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Yehudah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: So every man of Israel went up from after David, {and} followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And Dawid came to his house at Yerushalayim; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.am: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women {his} concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood. {ward: Heb. an house of ward} {shut...: Heb. bound} {living...: Heb. in widowhood of life}

verses.en: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Yehudah within three days, and be thou here present.
verses.am: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present. {Assemble: Heb. Call}

verses.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Yehudah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.am: So Amasa went to assemble {the men of} Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him. {Assemble: Heb. Call}

verses.en: And Dawid said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
verses.am: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than {did} Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us. {escape...: Heb. deliver himself from our eyes}

verses.en: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Yerushalayim, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.am: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.am: When they {were} at the great stone which {is} in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle {with} a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

verses.en: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
verses.am: And Joab said to Amasa, {Art} thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

verses.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.am: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that {was} in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth {rib}, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri. {struck...: Heb. doubled not his stroke}

verses.en: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for Dawid, let him go after Joab.
verses.am: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that {is} for David, {let him go} after Joab.

verses.en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.am: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

verses.en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.am: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.en: And he went through all the tribes of Yisra'el unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.am: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

verses.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.am: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that {were} with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down. {in the trench: or, against the outmost wall} {battered: Heb. marred to throw down}

verses.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
verses.am: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

verses.en: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.am: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, {Art} thou Joab? And he answered, I {am he}. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

verses.en: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
verses.am: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask {counsel} at Abel: and so they ended {the matter}. {They were...: or, They plainly spake in the beginning, saying, Surely they will ask of Abel, and so make an end}

verses.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Yisra'el: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Yisra'el: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of YAHUAH?
verses.am: I {am one of them that are} peaceable {and} faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?

verses.en: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.am: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

verses.en: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against Dawid: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
verses.am: The matter {is} not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, {even} against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall. {by name: Heb. by his name}

verses.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Yerushalayim unto the king.
verses.am: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast {it} out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king. {retired: Heb. were scattered}

verses.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Yisra'el: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
verses.am: Now Joab {was} over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

verses.en: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
verses.am: And Adoram {was} over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud {was} recorder: {recorder: or, remembrancer}

verses.en: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.am: And Sheva {was} scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar {were} the priests:

verses.en: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about Dawid.
verses.am: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David. {a chief...: or, a prince}

verses.en: Then there was a famine in the days of Dawid three years, year after year; and Dawid enquired of YAHUAH. And YAHUAH answered, It is for Sha'ul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.am: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, {It is} for Saul, and for {his} bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites. {enquired...: Heb. sought the face, etc}

verses.en: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Yisra'el, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Yisra'el had sworn unto them: and Sha'ul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Yisra'el and Yehudah.)
verses.am: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites {were} not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

verses.en: Wherefore Dawid said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of YAHUAH?
verses.am: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?

verses.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Sha'ul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Yisra'el. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.am: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, {that} will I do for you. {We will...: or, It is not silver nor gold that we have to do with Saul or his house, neither pertains it to us to kill, etc}

verses.en: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Yisra'el,
verses.am: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us {that} we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel, {devised...: or, cut us off}

verses.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto YAHUAH in Gibeah of Sha'ul, whom YAHUAH did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.am: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, {whom} the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give {them}. {whom...: or, chosen of the LORD}

verses.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Sha'ul, because of YAHUAH's oath that was between them, between Dawid and Jonathan the son of Sha'ul.
verses.am: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD'S oath that {was} between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

verses.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Sha'ul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Sha'ul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.am: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite: {Michal: or, Michal's sister} {brought...: Heb. bear to Adriel}

verses.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before YAHUAH: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.am: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell {all} seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first {days}, in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.am: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

verses.en: And it was told Dawid what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Sha'ul, had done.
verses.am: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

verses.en: And Dawid went and took the bones of Sha'ul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Sha'ul in Gilboa:
verses.am: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

verses.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Sha'ul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.am: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

verses.en: And the bones of Sha'ul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that YAHUAH was intreated for the land.
verses.am: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

verses.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Yisra'el; and Dawid went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and Dawid waxed faint.
verses.am: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

verses.en: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain Dawid.
verses.am: And Ishbibenob, which {was} of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear {weighed} three hundred {shekels} of brass in weight, he being girded with a new {sword}, thought to have slain David. {the giant: or, Rapha} {spear: Heb. the staff, or, the head}

verses.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of Dawid sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Yisra'el.
verses.am: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel. {light: Heb. candle, or, lamp}

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
verses.am: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which {was} of the sons of the giant. {the giant: or, Rapha} {Saph: or, Sippai}

verses.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
verses.am: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew {the brother of} Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear {was} like a weaver's beam. {Jaareoregim: or, Jair}

verses.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.am: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of {great} stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant. {the giant: or, Rapha}

verses.en: And when he defied Yisra'el, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of Dawid slew him.
verses.am: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him. {defied: or, reproached} {Shimea: also called, Shammah}

verses.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of Dawid, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.am: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.en: And Dawid spake unto YAHUAH the words of this song in the day that YAHUAH had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Sha'ul:
verses.am: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day {that} the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

verses.en: And he said, YAHUAH is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.am: And he said, The LORD {is} my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

verses.en: YAHUAH of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.am: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: {he is} my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

verses.en: I will call on YAHUAH, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.am: I will call on the LORD, {who is} worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.en: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.am: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid; {waves: or, pangs} {ungodly...: Heb. Belial}

verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.am: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me; {sorrows: or, cords}

verses.en: In my distress I called upon YAHUAH, and cried to my YAHUAH: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
verses.am: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry {did enter} into his ears.

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.am: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.am: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by, etc}

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
verses.am: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness {was} under his feet.

verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.am: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

verses.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.am: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, {and} thick clouds of the skies. {dark...: Heb. binding of waters}

verses.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.am: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

verses.en: YAHUAH thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.am: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

verses.en: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.am: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

verses.en: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of YAHUAH, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.am: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

verses.en: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.am: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters; {many: or, great}

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.am: He delivered me from my strong enemy, {and} from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but YAHUAH was my stay.
verses.am: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.am: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.en: YAHUAH rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.am: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of YAHUAH, and have not wickedly departed from my YAHUAH.
verses.am: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.en: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.am: For all his judgments {were} before me: and {as for} his statutes, I did not depart from them.

verses.en: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.am: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. to}

verses.en: Therefore YAHUAH hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.am: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}

verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.am: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, {and} with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.am: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury. {shew thyself unsavoury: or, wrestle}

verses.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
verses.am: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes {are} upon the haughty, {that} thou mayest bring {them} down.

verses.en: For thou art my lamp, O YAHUAH: and YAHUAH will lighten my darkness.
verses.am: For thou {art} my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness. {lamp: or, candle}

verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my YAHUAH have I leaped over a wall.
verses.am: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run: or, broken}

verses.en: As for YAHUAH, his way is perfect; the word of YAHUAH is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.am: {As for} God, his way {is} perfect; the word of the LORD {is} tried: he {is} a buckler to all them that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}

verses.en: For who is YAHUAH, save YAHUAH? and who is a rock, save our YAHUAH?
verses.am: For who {is} God, save the LORD? and who {is} a rock, save our God?

verses.en: YAHUAH is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.am: God {is} my strength {and} power: and he maketh my way perfect. {maketh: Heb. riddeth, or, looseth}

verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.am: He maketh my feet like hinds' {feet}: and setteth me upon my high places. {maketh: Heb. equalleth}

verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.am: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. {to war: Heb. for the war}

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.am: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great. {made...: Heb. multiplied me}

verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.am: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. {feet: Heb. ankles}

verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.am: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

verses.en: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.am: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.am: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.am: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.en: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto YAHUAH, but he answered them not.
verses.am: They looked, but {there was} none to save; {even} unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

verses.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
verses.am: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, {and} did spread them abroad.

verses.en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
verses.am: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me {to be} head of the heathen: a people {which} I knew not shall serve me.

verses.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.am: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. {Strangers: Heb. Sons of the stranger} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie}

verses.en: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.am: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

verses.en: YAHUAH liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be YAHUAH of the rock of my salvation.
verses.am: The LORD liveth; and blessed {be} my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

verses.en: It is YAHUAH that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
verses.am: It {is} God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me, {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengement for}

verses.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.am: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O YAHUAH, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.am: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

verses.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto Dawid, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.am: {He is} the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.en: Now these be the last words of Dawid. Dawid the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob, and the sweet psalmist of Yisra'el, said,
verses.am: Now these {be} the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man {who was} raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

verses.en: The Spirit of YAHUAH spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.am: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word {was} in my tongue.

verses.en: YAHUAH of Yisra'el said, the Rock of Yisra'el spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of YAHUAH.
verses.am: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men {must be} just, ruling in the fear of God. {He...: or, Be thou ruler, etc}

verses.en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.am: And {he shall be} as the light of the morning, {when} the sun riseth, {even} a morning without clouds; {as} the tender grass {springing} out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

verses.en: Although my house be not so with YAHUAH; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.am: Although my house {be} not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all {things}, and sure: for {this is} all my salvation, and all {my} desire, although he make {it} not to grow.

verses.en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.am: But {the sons} of Belial {shall be} all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

verses.en: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.am: But the man {that} shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the {same} place. {fenced: Heb. filled}

verses.en: These be the names of the mighty men whom Dawid had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.am: These {be} the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same {was} Adino the Eznite: {he lift up his spear} against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time. {The Tachmonite...: or, Joshebbassebet the Tachmonite, head of the three} {whom he...: Heb. slain} {he lift...: from (1ch:) whom he...: Heb. slain}

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with Dawid, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Yisra'el were gone away:
verses.am: And after him {was} Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, {one} of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines {that} were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

verses.en: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and YAHUAH wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.am: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

verses.en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.am: And after him {was} Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines. {into...: or, for foraging}

verses.en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and YAHUAH wrought a great victory.
verses.am: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

verses.en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to Dawid in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.am: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim. {three...: or, the three captains over the thirty}

verses.en: And Dawid was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.am: And David {was} then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines {was} then {in} Bethlehem.

verses.en: And Dawid longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!
verses.am: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which {is} by the gate!

verses.en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to Dawid: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that {was} by the gate, and took {it}, and brought {it} to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.

verses.en: And he said, Be it far from me, O YAHUAH, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.am: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: {is not this} the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

verses.en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.am: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, {and} slew {them}, and had the name among three. {and slew them: Heb. slain}

verses.en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.am: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the {first} three.

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.am: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow: {who...: Heb. great of acts} {lionlike...: Heb. lion of God}

verses.en: And he slew an Mitsri, a goodly man: and the Mitsri had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Mitsri's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.am: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear. {a goodly...: Heb. a man of countenance, or, sight: also called, a man of great stature}

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.am: These {things} did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

verses.en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And Dawid set him over his guard.
verses.am: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the {first} three. And David set him over his guard. {more...: or, honourable among the thirty} {guard: or, council: Heb. at his command}

verses.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.am: Asahel the brother of Joab {was} one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

verses.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.am: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

verses.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.am: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

verses.en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.am: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

verses.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.am: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

verses.en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.am: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

verses.en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.am: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash, {brooks: or, valleys}

verses.en: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.am: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

verses.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.am: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

verses.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.am: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

verses.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.am: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

verses.en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.am: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

verses.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.am: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

verses.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.am: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.am: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

verses.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.am: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

verses.en: And again the anger of YAHUAH was kindled against Yisra'el, and he moved Dawid against them to say, Go, number Yisra'el and Yehudah.
verses.am: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

verses.en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Yisra'el, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
verses.am: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which {was} with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people. {Go: or, Compass}

verses.en: And Joab said unto the king, Now YAHUAH thy YAHUAH add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.am: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see {it}: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

verses.en: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

verses.en: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
verses.am: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that {lieth} in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer: {river: or, valley}

verses.en: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,
verses.am: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon, {land of Tahtimhodshi: or, nether land newly inhabited}

verses.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Yehudah, even to Beersheba.
verses.am: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, {even} to Beersheba.

verses.en: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Yerushalayim at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.am: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Yisra'el eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Yehudah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.am: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah {were} five hundred thousand men.

verses.en: And Dawid's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And Dawid said unto YAHUAH, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O YAHUAH, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.am: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.en: For when Dawid was up in the morning, the word of YAHUAH came unto the prophet Gad, Dawid's seer, saying,
verses.am: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

verses.en: Go and say unto Dawid, Thus saith YAHUAH, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.am: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three {things}; choose thee one of them, that I may {do it} unto thee.

verses.en: So Gad came to Dawid, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.am: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

verses.en: And Dawid said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of YAHUAH; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.am: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies {are} great: and let me not fall into the hand of man. {are great: or, are many}

verses.en: So YAHUAH sent a pestilence upon Yisra'el from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
verses.am: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.

verses.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Yerushalayim to destroy it, YAHUAH repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of YAHUAH was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.am: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite. {Araunah: also called, Ornan}

verses.en: And Dawid spake unto YAHUAH when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
verses.am: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

verses.en: And Gad came that day to Dawid, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto YAHUAH in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.am: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite. {Araunah: Heb. Araniah}

verses.en: And Dawid, according to the saying of Gad, went up as YAHUAH commanded.
verses.am: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

verses.en: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.am: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

verses.en: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And Dawid said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto YAHUAH, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.am: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.en: And Araunah said unto Dawid, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.am: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what {seemeth} good unto him: behold, {here be} oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and {other} instruments of the oxen for wood.

verses.en: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, YAHUAH thy YAHUAH accept thee.
verses.am: All these {things} did Araunah, {as} a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

verses.en: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto YAHUAH my YAHUAH of that which doth cost me nothing. So Dawid bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.am: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy {it} of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.en: And Dawid built there an altar unto YAHUAH, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So YAHUAH was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Yisra'el.
verses.am: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
